title: 2 John Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on 2 John 1: the elder and the chosen lady, walking in truth, the commandment to love one another, and the deceivers who must not be welcomed.

questions.text: How does the writer of this letter describe himself in the first verse?
questions.explanation: 2 John 1:1 opens with "The elder, to the chosen lady and her children".

answers.text: As the elder
As an apostle
As a servant
As a prophet

questions.text: To whom is this letter addressed?
questions.explanation: 2 John 1:1 says the letter is to the chosen lady and her children, whom the writer loves in truth.

answers.text: Gaius the beloved
The chosen lady and her children
The seven assemblies in Asia
The brother of James

questions.text: Which three things does the letter say will be with us from God the Father?
questions.explanation: 2 John 1:3 says grace, mercy, and peace will be with us, from God the Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

answers.text: Faith, hope, and love
Glory, honor, and power
Grace, mercy, and peace
Wisdom, strength, and riches

questions.text: What made the writer rejoice greatly?
questions.explanation: 2 John 1:4 says he rejoices greatly that he has found some of her children walking in truth.

answers.text: He received a gift from her house
The deceivers had left the world
He had already come to see her
He found some of her children walking in truth

questions.text: Which commandment, held from the beginning, does the writer beg her to keep?
questions.explanation: 2 John 1:5 says it is not a new commandment but the one they had from the beginning, that we love one another.

answers.text: That we love one another
That we keep the day of rest
That we welcome every teacher
That we write no more letters

questions.text: What does this letter say love is?
questions.explanation: 2 John 1:6 says this is love, that we should walk according to his commandments.

answers.text: That we should speak kindly to all
That we should give away all we own
That we should walk according to his commandments
That we should stay silent about evil

questions.text: What do the many deceivers refuse to confess?
questions.explanation: 2 John 1:7 says many deceivers have gone out into the world who do not confess that Jesus Christ came in the flesh.

answers.text: That the Father sent the prophets
That Jesus Christ came in the flesh
That the elder speaks the truth
That the commandment is old

questions.text: What does the letter say about whoever does not remain in the teaching of Christ?
questions.explanation: 2 John 1:9 says that whoever transgresses and does not remain in the teaching of Christ does not have God.

answers.text: He has the Father but not the Son
He will soon be taught again
He still receives a full reward
He does not have God

questions.text: What are they told to do if someone comes without this teaching?
questions.explanation: 2 John 1:10 tells them not to receive such a person into their house and not to welcome him.

answers.text: Not receive him into the house and not welcome him
Give him a full reward for his work
Send him on his journey with a gift
Ask him to teach all the children

questions.text: Why does the writer not want to write with paper and ink?
questions.explanation: 2 John 1:12 says he hopes to come and speak face to face, that their joy may be made full.

answers.text: He has run out of paper
He is afraid of the deceivers
He hopes to come and speak face to face
He has nothing more to say
